// diagnostic

E0928

A `#Job fn` clashes with a registered Jet command or repeats a job name in one scope (D-JET-VERBS1=A)

What

A `#Job fn` clashes with a registered Jet command or repeats a job name in one scope (D-JET-VERBS1=A)

Why

Top-level commands and jobs must have distinct names, and `jet <name>` must select exactly one function

Fix

Rename the job, e.g. `#Job fn lint_all()`, or give same-named jobs different scopes.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0928: tests/ui/E0928_job_reserved_name.stderr.

Error [E0928]: `lint` is reserved by Jet's command line
  --> E0928_job_reserved_name.jet:9:1
    |
  9 | #Job fn lint() {
    | ^^^^
 Why: `lint` is a Jet command; top-level jobs must have distinct names
 Fix: Rename the job, e.g. `#Job fn lint_all()`
